Dena (PeopleOps): We'll publish transcript and recording. If headcount/support questions, DM me.

OpsBot: Calendar invite created and sent to @channel :calendar:

Julia (CEO): Thanks — please prioritize customer-impacting incidents and security/regulatory Qs. I'll do 15 min AMA. :raised_hands:

6) Pricing roadmap note (Ricardo) — 5m

8) Action items & wrap — 5m

Samir (Product): LGTM :thumbsup:

Dena (PeopleOps): Reminder: drop any people/headcount Qs in the form. We'll anonymize for the AMA if requested.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — 2 hours before.

RecordingBot: Post-meeting note: we'll upload recording & transcript to #all-hands and drive after the meeting.

Elaine (Ops): Meeting done — recording posted: https://videos.redwood/allhands/1798123456

Elaine (Ops): TL;DR takeaways:
- Dedicated GA on track for Oct 15 with performance improvements.
- Data residency policy: new region-by-region opt-in; Security to publish config by Monday.
- Incident follow-up: rolling fixes deployed; SRE to run fire drills weekly for two cycles.
- Action: All teams review rollback playbooks by EOD Mon and flag gaps in the tracker.

Julia (CEO): Great meeting — big thanks. Main ask: focus on predictable SLAs for Dedicated customers. I'll follow up in 1:1s.

Marc (Eng): I'll set up follow-ups for rollout playbook and schedule a runbook review with Eng-SRE.

Ricardo (Sales): Thanks — I'll coordinate a customer comms draft with Product.

Dena (PeopleOps): Headcount update Qs — send to me; we'll do a selective Q&A doc.

Elaine (Ops): Closing notes: if you want slides or clarifications, post here or DM. :sparkles:
